basic.name: Drag
basic.description:
Dehaka lashes out his tongue, dealing 160~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy hit, Stunning and dragging them with him for 1.75 seconds.

If Dehaka is Stunned or Silenced while using Drag, the effect ends.

basic.name: Dark Swarm
basic.description: Deal 48~~0.04~~ damage every 0.5 seconds to nearby enemies for 3.5 seconds. While active, you are able to move through units. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

basic.name: Burrow
basic.description: Burrow into the ground, entering Stasis and becoming Invulnerable for 2 seconds. While Burrowed, Dehaka can move at 50% movement speed.

heroic.name: Isolation
heroic.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200~~0.04~~ damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Adaptation
heroic.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

trait.name: Essence Collection
trait.description:
Heal Dehaka for 29~~0.04~~ Health per stored Essence over 5 seconds. Can be cast during Drag and Burrow.

Passive: Gain 10 Essence from Takedowns and 2 Essence from nearby Minions dying. Maximum of 50 Essence.

mount.name: Brushstalker
mount.description:
Activate to burrow to a bush on the Battleground.

Passive: Gain 20% movement speed while in a bush and for 2 seconds after leaving. 

Passive: Gathering a Regeneration Globe reduces the cooldown of Brushstalker by 40 seconds.

level1.name: Enduring Swarm
level1.description: Dark Swarm's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds and grants 50 Spell Armor while active.

level1.name: Tissue Regeneration
level1.description:
Regeneration Globes grant 10 Essence.

Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases Health Regeneration by 4, up to 40, and maximum Essence by 1, up to 10.

level1.name: Enhanced Agility
level1.description:
Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.

Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level4.name: Lurker Strain
level4.description:
Emerging from Burrow grants Dehaka Stealth for 3 seconds and knocks nearby enemies back, dealing 125~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.

Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Burrow by 2 seconds.

level4.name: One-Who-Collects
level4.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level4.name: Hero Stalker
level4.description: Increases Essence gained from Takedowns by 100%, and gain 1 Essence for each enemy Hero hit by Dark Swarm, up to 3 at once.

level7.name: Feeding Frenzy
level7.description:
Increase Drag's duration by 0.5 seconds.

Gambit: Basic Attacks reduce Drag's cooldown by 1.5 seconds. Every death reduces this cooldown reduction by 0.25 seconds, up to 3 times.

level7.name: Paralyzing Enzymes
level7.description: Drag Slows the target by 40% and reduces their healing received by 50% while active and for 2 seconds after ending. Dehaka's Basic Attacks increase the duration of the healing reduction to 2 seconds.

level7.name: Symbiosis
level7.description: Every time Dark Swarm damages an enemy Hero, reduce its cooldown by 0.4 seconds.

level10.name: Isolation
level10.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200~~0.04~~ damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level10.name: Adaptation
level10.description: After 4 seconds, heal for 100% of the damage Dehaka took over this period.

level13.name: Ferocious Stalker
level13.description: Dark Swarm Slows enemy Heroes by 15% for 0.75 seconds and deals 50% more damage while Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level13.name: Primal Swarm
level13.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level13.name: Primal Rage
level13.description: Gain 1.25% increased Attack Damage per Essence stored.

level16.name: Tunneling Claws
level16.description: Increase movement speed while Burrowing to 120%.

level16.name: Pack Leader
level16.description: Dehaka gains 40 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 4 seconds after leaving.

level20.name: Contagion
level20.description: Isolation hits all Heroes near the first target, but it deals 60% less damage to all targets.

level20.name: Change Is Survival
level20.description: Increases Adaptation healing to 200% of the damage received and reduces the cooldown by 40 seconds.

level20.name: Essence Claws
level20.description: Dehaka's Basic Attacks slow the target by 20% for 1 second. If the target is a Hero, Dehaka gains 5 Essence.

level20.name: Apex Predator
level20.description: Reduces Brushstalker's cooldown by 120 seconds and the cast time by 0.5 seconds.
